title: OmegaTheory V2: Lean 4 Formalization of Discrete Spacetime Substrate
description: Machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of OmegaTheory V2 — a discrete-spacetime substrate-truncation framework deriving quantum mechanics, gauge theory, and the Standard Model from four irrational existence postulates (pi, e, sqrt 2, Catalan G) on a Planck-scale Z^4 lattice. Built against Mathlib v4.29.0; depends only on Lean core axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) for paper-headline capstones. Includes formalizations of pi-transcendence (first in any prover), Roth's theorem on Diophantine approximation (in progress), Magnetic Laplacian spectral methods, and Lyapunov stability analysis.
